findings.text: UiSystemTestRunner TS-TEST-013 deterministically fails: before the cumulative assertion at lines 320-333, ui.pointer.entered has been published once by the ImageButton controller, once by the public-field-mutation identity fixture, and once by each Text, Image, and ScrollingFrame presentation-controller fixture, for five events total. The assertion still requires the cumulative count to equal 1, so waitUntil expires and the focused SLICE-001 gate cannot pass.
